title: French Open 2026: Sabalenka shines, Osaka dazzles as Medvedev melts down in Paris heat
summary: World number one Aryna Sabalenka powered into the French Open second round in style as Naomi Osaka lit up Roland Garros with fashion flair, while sixth seed Daniil Medvedev suffered another early Paris exit on a sweltering day that tested players and fans alike.
